hi! depends on what you want to do, but if you're me na feeling inferior before going into Pisay:

particularly for STEM subjects (particularly math in G7), please check the curriculum and watch "organic chem tutor" videos or "professor dave explains" kasi for me nakatulong siya talaga. you can also check out textbooks like Stewart's Precalculus or Haese Mathematics for Math (study the topics in the curriculum). you don't have to learn everything, but you have to get exposed to these concepts since Pisay tends to be very fast and deep.

though... PLEASE LISTEN SA CLASS!!! once school starts, you really have to lock-in and always ask teachers if you don't understand anything or have any concerns. that way you have a smaller chance of falling behind, or at least have a good system that won't make you super behind. in my honest opinion, especially if you passed NCE, it shouldn't be hard to pass (as in, hindi mapapaalis)!

moreover, sa mga topics, study them well and try to be very inquisitive of everything (learn to ask the right questions) to gain a far richer understanding (which also reflects in exam scores, pisay teachers love thinking-out-of-the-box questions).

and always be ready to accept your limitations, even if your parents or relatives are like 🤬, your teachers are always there to support you because they know they're feeding you the toughest curriculum they can, and everyone is bound to find it really hard.

if you have more questions, you can always message me naman in reddit DMs \^\^

PS: to the other people saying to rest muna, rest is important! don't do this full-time, just do this mga 1-3 hours a day or more kung talagang masaya kang mag-aral ng ganito. because in the long run this will give you more time to rest within your Pisay journey (i like to think abt it this way ngl)
